relationships.subject: Kartogenin
relationships.evidence_quote: The released KGN can stimulate the differentiation of ADSCs into a nucleus pulposus (NP) -like phenotype and boost antioxidant capacity of ADSCs via activating Nrf2/TXNIP/NLRP3 axis.

key_findings: KGN@PLGA-GelMA/PRP hydrogel delivering ADSCs attenuated rat intervertebral disc degeneration.
KGN boosted ADSC antioxidant capacity via the Nrf2/TXNIP/NLRP3 axis.
